label: 譲渡証文の本文と「薪買出し早割附」
summary: 湯屋売買契約書のひな形の本文。物件・道具一式・代金・地代・宗旨の証明まで盛り込む本格派。上段には役員当番表の締めくくり（六十四代・足かけ33年）と、薪の値段早見表「薪買出し早割附」が載る。

文人（ぶんにん）｛ニ相立候。依之｝何町何丁目、家主（いへぬし）誰（たれ）支配（しはい）｛の地面にて｝、男女両風呂・男一ト風呂、湯屋（ゆや）建家（たていへ）并（ならびに）商売（しゃうばい）附（つき）諸（しょ）道具（だうぐ）一式（いっしき）、別紙（べっし）帳面（ちゃうめん）之通（のとほ）り、渡世（とせい）｛為致候処｝実正（じっしゃう）也
右湯屋上り｛高之内を以、｝地代（ぢだい）｛并奉公人｝給金（きふきん）其外（そのほか）諸（しょ）入用（にふよう）｛共相賄、不足之節ハ文人方ゟ相弁可申候｝。湯屋（ゆや）家作（かさく）揚金（あげきん）として壱（いっ）ヶ月（かげつ）金何両何分づゝ、毎月（まいつき）｛晦日ニ急度｝差上（さしあげ）可（べく）申（まうし）候（さふらふ）。｛若又壱ヶ月ニ而も相滞候ハヾ｝、文人（ぶんにん）方（かた）ゟ（より）差上（さしあげ）｛可申候。敷｝金として、金何拾両｛相渡置申候｝
右湯屋｛主人ゟ明渡し候様申候ハヾ、何時成とも｝早速（さっそく）｛明渡（あけわた）し｝、商売（しゃうばい）附（つき）道具（だうぐ）諸（しょ）帳面（ちゃうめん）不残（のこらず）｛相渡シ可申候。其節敷金之儀ハ｝相違（さうゐ）無（な）く｛御返済可被下候｝

sections.modern:
その請人（保証人）に立ちます。ついては、◯町◯丁目、家主◯◯の支配地にある湯屋（男女両風呂か男湯だけかを記す）の建物と商売道具一式を、別紙の帳面のとおり（この者に）渡世させることは確かです。」
続いて金銭の取り決め。湯屋のあがり高の中から、地代や奉公人の給金その他の諸費用をまかない、足りなければ請人の方で負担します。湯屋の家作の「揚金（あげきん）」として、ひと月◯両◯分ずつ、毎月晦日にきっと納めます。もしひと月でも滞ったら、請人の方から納めます。敷金として金◯十両をお渡ししておきます。
右の湯屋は、持ち主から明け渡しを求められたら、いつでもすぐに明け渡し、商売道具と帳面類は残らずお引き渡しします。その際、敷金は間違いなくご返済ください。
一、お上のご法度は言うまでもなく、諸々のお触れは堅く守り、町の決まりも守ります。火の元のことは、とりわけ念を入れて大切にさせます。
一、宗旨は代々◯宗で、◯町◯寺の檀家に間違いありませんので、寺手形（寺請証文）は請人の方で預かっておき、もし必要なときはいつでも差し出します。
sections.english:
we stand as bunnin (guarantor) for this person. Accordingly, the bathhouse building (state whether it has both men’s and women’s baths or a men’s bath only) on land at Block ____ of ____ Town managed by landlord ____, together with the full set of business equipment as listed in the attached ledger, we truly let him run as his trade.”
Next come the money terms. Out of the bathhouse’s takings, the ground rent, the servants’ wages and other expenses are to be covered, and any shortfall made good by the guarantor. As “agekin” (rent) for the bathhouse building, ____ ryō ____ bu a month is to be paid without fail on the last day of every month. Should even one month fall into arrears, the guarantor will pay it. As a security deposit, ____ ryō in gold is handed over.
Should the owner ask for the bathhouse back, it will be vacated at once, at any time, and the business equipment and all ledgers handed over without exception; the deposit is then to be returned without fail.
Item: Not to mention the laws of the authorities, all official notices will be strictly obeyed, and the rules of the town kept. Fire above all will be guarded with special care.
Item: His family has belonged for generations to the ____ sect, as a parishioner of ____ Temple in ____ Town without question; the temple certificate is kept by the guarantor and will be produced at any time it is needed.
sections.note: 江戸の売渡証文・請状の型（「…之通り…実正也」「御公儀様御法度之儀は不及申」「宗旨之儀は代々何宗にて何寺旦那」「若壱ヶ月ニ而も相滞候ハヾ…」）と照らして本文を起こしました。「男女両風呂・男一ト風呂」は割書きで、どちらかを選んで書く欄。23丁の株数調べと同じ区分です。宗旨・寺手形はキリシタン禁制下の身元証明で、江戸の契約の必須項目でした。国会図書館本の原寸画像で、「揚金として壱ヶ月金何両何分づゝ、毎月晦日ニ急度差上可申候」「文人方ゟ差上可申候。敷金として」「何時成とも早速明渡し」「火之元之儀ハ別而入念大切ニ」「寺手形文人方ニ取置」が読めます。地代・給金をあがり高でまかなう段、明け渡しの条件、敷金返済の段は、崩れの強い部分を型と字形の残りから推測で補いました（｛｝の箇所）。「文人」は、文脈から受人（うけにん＝請人、保証人）とみるのが最も自然です。①30丁末〜31丁頭が「此誰と申者、生国能く存じ慥かなる者故、文人ニ相立」と、奉公人請状の「請人に相立つ」と同じ型、②揚金が滞れば文人方から納め、寺手形も文人方で預かる＝保証人の役目、③32丁の結びでは同じ役回りが「請人引請急度埒明」と「請人」の字で出る、④署名欄の「文人・人主」は請状の定型「請人・人主」と同じ組み合わせ。「受」の崩しが「文」に似るため、字形は「文人」のまま残しています。
sections.noteEn: The text was read against the standard forms of Edo deeds and letters of guarantee (“…as listed … this is true,” “not to mention the laws of the authorities,” “for generations of the ____ sect, parishioner of ____ Temple,” “should even one month fall into arrears …”). “Both baths / men’s bath only” is printed in small split lines, a blank where you choose one—the same categories as the license counts on spread 23. Religious affiliation and the temple certificate were proof of identity under the ban on Christianity, and a required item in Edo contracts. In a full-resolution image of the National Diet Library copy one can read “as agekin, ____ ryō ____ bu a month, to be paid without fail on the last day of every month,” “the bunnin will pay it; as a deposit …,” “vacated at once, at any time,” “fire above all is to be guarded with special care,” and “the temple certificate is kept by the bunnin.” The passage on covering rent and wages from the takings, the terms of vacating, and the return of the deposit are heavily cursive and have been filled in by conjecture from the standard wording and the visible strokes (the parts in braces). From context, “bunnin” is best taken as ukenin (請人/受人), the guarantor: (1) the end of spread 30 and the start of 31 read “This person … being well known to us and trustworthy, we stand as bunnin,” the same pattern as a servant’s letter of guarantee (“stand as guarantor”); (2) the bunnin pays if the rent falls into arrears and keeps the temple certificate—a guarantor’s duties; (3) on spread 32 the same role appears written as “the guarantor (請人) will take it on and settle it”; (4) the signature pair “bunnin / sponsor” matches the standard “guarantor / sponsor” of a letter of guarantee. Because a cursive 受 can look like 文, the characters are left as 文人.

sections.original:
六十四代相続（あひつづ）き、文化七午年五月十八日番組定（さだ）まり、天保十三寅年三月三日湯株滅却（めっきゃく）せし年数三十三年なり。
大行事諸帳面預（あづか）り、三番組｛ゟ四番組へ相渡す｝
sections.modern:
大行事は六十四代まで続いた。文化7年（1810）5月18日に番組が定まってから、天保13年（1842）3月3日に湯株が廃止されるまで、足かけ33年。
大行事が預かっていた組合の諸帳面は、三番組から四番組へ引き継がれた。
sections.english:
The guild officers served sixty-four terms. From the 18th day of the 5th month of Bunka 7 (1810), when the groups were established, to the 3rd day of the 3rd month of Tenpō 13 (1842), when the bathhouse licenses were abolished: thirty-three years, counting inclusively.
The guild’s account books, kept by the officers, were handed over from Group Three to Group Four.
sections.note: 上段に載る、25〜30丁の役員当番表の締めくくり（以前の版では読み落としていました）。当番表の最後、第六十四期（天保13年3月〜）の当番は三番組で、帳面がその次の四番組へ渡ったという記述と順番が合います。1810〜1842年は足かけ33年で、21丁の「丹誠の株わづかに卅三年」とも一致します。末尾の「四番組へ相渡す」は読みが未確定です。
sections.noteEn: Printed in the upper band, this closes the officers’ rotation chart that runs across spreads 25–30 (an earlier version missed it). The last term in the chart, term 64 (from the 3rd month of Tenpō 13), fell to Group Three, which fits the statement that the books then passed to Group Four. 1810–1842 is thirty-three years counted inclusively, matching “our hard-won licenses lasted a mere thirty-three years” on spread 21. The final words, “handed over to Group Four,” are an uncertain reading.

sections.modern: 薪の買い出し用の早見表。下の数字が薪1〆（貫）の値段（文）、上がそのとき60文で買える薪の量です。ト・ノ・毛はそれぞれ1〆の10分の1・100分の1・1000分の1の位。たとえば相場が65文なら0.923〆（九ト弐ノ三毛）、70文なら0.857〆（八ト五ノ七毛）。そろばんいらずの実用表で、百八十五文まで続きます。
sections.english: A ready-reckoner for buying firewood. The lower figure is the price of one kan (〆) of firewood in mon; the upper figure is how much firewood 60 mon will buy at that price. To, no, and mō are the tenths, hundredths, and thousandths of a kan. At 65 mon, for example, 60 mon buys 0.923 kan (9-to 2-no 3-mō); at 70 mon, 0.857 kan. A practical table that spares you the abacus, continuing up to 185 mon.
sections.note: 数字を「60÷相場」で計算し直すと、次の丁まで含めた全28行のうち27行が四捨五入（一部は切り捨て）の値とぴたり一致しました。この検算で、以前の版で〓としていた字（「九ト弐ノ三毛」の弐、「八ト五ノ七毛」の五）が確定し、「〆」と読んでいた末尾の字は「毛」と直しました。湯語教で「収入は薪代に食われる」と歌われた、その薪の仕入れ実務です。
sections.noteEn: Recomputing the figures as “60 ÷ price” shows that 27 of the 28 rows (counting the next spread) match the rounded (occasionally truncated) values exactly. This check settled two characters an earlier version marked as illegible and corrected a final character misread as 〆 to mō. It is the hands-on business of buying the very firewood that the Yugokyō complained “eats up the income.”
